adjudication.design_quote: We estimated the effect size of each pharmacotherapy against the control using a traditional meta-analysis of head-to-head comparisons (direct comparison evidence)
adjudication.k_quote: Thirteen randomized controlled trials (529 participants) were included after a screen of 1774 articles.
adjudication.reason: NMA that also reports a traditional pairwise meta-analysis of direct comparisons, which counts as pairwise under C2.

trial_inventory.title: Pamidronate effect compared with a steroid on complex regional pain syndrome type I: pilot randomised trial.
trial_inventory.inclusion_quote: Eun Young et al., 2016 [ 11 ] 21 First-ever stroke Parallel Pamidronate, 60 mg/session, 3 infusions every two days for six days IV; 2 weeks Oral prednisolone 1 mg/kg/day 100-VAS Post-treatment

trial_inventory.title: Long-term prednisolone in post-stroke complex regional pain syndrome.
trial_inventory.inclusion_quote: [ 12 ] 58 Stroke Parallel Prednisolone, 10 mg/day for 2 months Oral; 4 weeks No prednisolone 100-VAS Post-treatment

trial_inventory.title: Phase I/II parallel double-blind randomized controlled clinical trial of perispinal etanercept for chronic stroke: improved mobility and pain alleviation.
trial_inventory.inclusion_quote: [ 13 ] 26 Ischemic stroke in MCA territory; ICH stroke in basal ganglia Parallel Etanercept, 25 mg Peri-spinal; 2 weeks 0.9% saline 100-VAS or 10-NRS Post-treatment

trial_inventory.title: Intravenous lidocaine in central pain: a double-blind, placebo-controlled, psychophysical study.
trial_inventory.inclusion_quote: [ 19 ] 16 Stroke or spinal cord injury Cross-over, 3-week washout Lidocaine, 5 mg/kg/day IV; 3 weeks 0.9% saline 100-VAS Until post-infusion

trial_inventory.title: Effects of IV morphine in central pain: a randomized placebo-controlled study.
trial_inventory.inclusion_quote: [ 20 ] 16 Stroke or spinal cord injury Cross-over, 3-week washout Morphine (9-30 mg/day; 16 ± 6.1 mg per day in average) IV; 3 weeks 0.9% saline 100-VAS Until post-infusion

trial_inventory.title: A double-blind trial of naloxone in central post-stroke pain.
trial_inventory.inclusion_quote: [ 21 ] 20 Stroke Cross-over, 2-week washout Naloxone, 8 mg/session IV; 2 weeks 0.9% saline 100-VAS Until post-infusion

trial_inventory.title: Levetiracetam in patients with central neuropathic post-stroke pain—a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial.
trial_inventory.inclusion_quote: [ 22 ] 42 Stroke Cross-over, 2-week washout Levetiracetam, started at 1000 mg and increased every 2 weeks to 3000 mg Oral; 8 weeks Placebo pills 10-NRS Post-treatment

trial_inventory.title: Safety and efficacy of pregabalin in patients with central post-stroke pain.
trial_inventory.inclusion_quote: [ 23 ] 219 Stroke Parallel Pregabalin, 150-600 mg/day Oral; 12 weeks Placebo pills 10-NRS Post-treatment

trial_inventory.title: Amitriptyline in the prophylaxis of central poststroke pain. Preliminary results of 39 patients in a placebo-controlled, long-term study.
trial_inventory.inclusion_quote: [ 24 ] 39 Acute thalamic stroke Parallel Amitriptyline, 10-75 mg Oral; 52 weeks Placebo pills NA Censor point within one year

trial_inventory.title: Central post-stroke pain—a controlled trial of amitriptyline and carbamazepine.
trial_inventory.inclusion_quote: [ 25 ] 15 Stroke Cross-over, 1-week washout Amitriptyline, 12.5-50 mg Oral; 4 weeks Carbamazepine (200-800 mg) or placebo pills 10-step verbal scale Post-treatment

trial_inventory.title: Lamotrigine for central poststroke pain: a randomized controlled trial.
trial_inventory.inclusion_quote: Vesterguard et al., 2001 [ 26 ] 27 Stroke Cross-over, 2-week washout Lamotrigine, tapered from 25 mg/day to 200 mg/d Oral; 8 weeks Placebo pills 10-NRS Post-treatment

trial_inventory.title: Iontophoretic administration of S(+)-ketamine in patients with intractable central pain: a placebo-controlled trial.
trial_inventory.inclusion_quote: [ 27 ] 33 Stroke, spinal cord lesion or other central nervous lesions Parallel Ketamine 50-75 mg/session, 5 sessions Self-powered disposable patch; one week Placebo patch 100-VAS Post-treatment

trial_inventory.title: Pregabalin in patients with central neuropathic pain: a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of a flexible-dose regimen.
trial_inventory.inclusion_quote: [ 28 ] 40 Stroke, spinal cord lesion or other central nervous lesions Parallel Pregabalin, 150-600 mg/day, 4 weeks Oral; 4 weeks Placebo pills 100-VAS Post-treatment
